points.description: Balances/evens out fluctuating flows or concentrations (flow and strength/load) of the waste water, giving a more uniform feed to downstream treatment.
points.partial_credit: Half if only flow or only concentration is mentioned vaguely, or says 'storage' without balancing/uniformity.

points.description: Assists self-neutralization (mixing acidic and alkaline wastes so pH is neutralized).
points.partial_credit: Half if only says it helps control/adjust pH without the idea of wastes neutralizing each other.

points.description: Evens out/dilutes the effect of periodic slug discharges from batch processes.
points.partial_credit: Half if mentions shock/sudden loads or batch discharge without the evening-out idea.

rubric.notes: Marks are shared across the three roles in the model answer, with the 2 marks capped at the total. Give 2 for all three roles, or for the balancing idea plus one other role stated clearly; give part marks for vague or half-stated ideas. Give 0 for unrelated roles such as settling solids or removing BOD.
